data.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now

content.basic: Despite the turmoil Nvidia is in after the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company projected that its streak of record-breaking revenue isn't about to stop.

data.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future  deals in doubt

content.basic: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
